description_en: Queries the available deployment profiles for a specified model, including inference frameworks, scenarios, optimization combinations, supported device types, and member summaries
description_zh: 查询指定模型当前的可部署方案，包含推理框架、场景、优化组合、支持卡型和成员摘要
name: ListModelDeploymentProfiles

parameters.help_en: The ID of the model to deploy
parameters.name: model_id

parameters.help_en: The model version. If this parameter is not specified, the latest deployable version in the model registry is used
parameters.help_zh: 模型版本；省略时使用模型表中的最新可部署版本
parameters.name: model_version

parameters.help_en: The business rule key. Leave this parameter empty for standard ModelGallery. Set this parameter to cmu-biz for TokenWorks
parameters.help_zh: 业务规则键。标准 ModelGallery 不传，TokenWorks 传 cmu-biz
parameters.name: biz_key

ModelId.description_en: The model ID corresponding to the request

ModelVersion.description_en: The model version corresponding to the request. If this request parameter is not specified, the latest deployable version in the model registry is returned
ModelVersion.description_zh: 请求对应的模型版本。未设置该请求参数时，返回模型表中的最新可部署版本

Category.description_en:
The scenario category. Valid values:
singlenode: single-node.
multinodes: multi-node.
pd: prefill-decode disaggregation
Category.description_zh:
场景分类。可取值：
singlenode：单机
multinodes：多机
pd：PD分离

Devices.description_en: The list of device types supported by this deployment profile
Devices.description_zh: 该部署方案支持的卡型列表

DeviceCategory.description_en: The device vendor or device category

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the device type

InstanceTypes.description_en: The list of instance types currently mapped to this device type. This list does not reflect real-time inventory
InstanceTypes.description_zh: 该卡型当前对应的实例规格列表。（不是实时库存）

Framework.description_en: The inference framework. Valid values: sglang, vllm

additionalProperties.description_en: The value is of the String type

Labels.description_en: The display and business filtering labels for the deployment profile, represented as a string-to-string key-value object
Labels.description_zh: 部署方案的展示和业务筛选标签，采用字符串到字符串的键值对象

MemberType.description_en:
The member type. Valid values:
Default: Non-prefill-decode disaggregation.
LLMPrefill: Prefill service in prefill-decode disaggregation.
LLMDecode: Decode service in prefill-decode disaggregation
MemberType.description_zh:
成员类型。取值：
Default：非PD分离。
LLMPrefill：PD分离-Prefill服务。
LLMDecode：PD分离-Decode服务

Meta.description_en: The extended metadata of the member, represented as a string-to-string key-value object. Currently defines script. Callers should preserve unknown keys
Meta.description_zh: 成员扩展元数据，采用字符串到字符串的键值对象。当前定义 script，调用方应保留未知键

additionalProperties.description_en: The value is of the String type

ProfileId.description_en: The deployment profile ID. Callers must not compute or modify this value
ProfileId.description_zh: 部署方案ID。调用方不得自行计算或修改

Scenario.description_en: The deployment scenario, such as singlenode-balanced or pd-balanced

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of deployment profiles
